prompt: Leave the voicemail Dad leaves after hearing about your promotion. He is very proud. He will not say that.
response:
Hey. It’s Dad.

Your mother told me the news. I see you’ve been putting in the hours. Always knew you had it in you to handle the responsibility.

Make sure you’re eating properly. And don’t let it go to your head—just keep doing the work the way you have been.

Call your mother when you get a minute. She wants to hear all about it.

Alright. Talk soon.
